result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but the promotional banner has a significant visual defect: white text on a pale green background is nearly unreadable. No other major layout or rendering issues were found.

issues.description: The promo banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') is white on a very light green background, resulting in extremely low contrast that makes it hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker green background or change the text color to a dark shade (e.g., dark green or near-black) to meet WCAG contrast requirements (at least 4.5:1 for body text).

issues.description: The 'Order now' button inside the promo banner uses green text on white, which reads fine, but combined with the washed-out banner text the whole promo block looks visually unfinished/broken.
issues.suggestion: Once the banner background/text contrast is fixed, verify the button still stands out; consider a filled dark-green button for stronger visual hierarchy.
